notes: Merck paid $10.8B all-cash for Prometheus's anti-TL1A monoclonal antibody (PRA023, later tulisokibart) — at the time the most advanced anti-TL1A asset in development. Phase 2 ARTEMIS-UC was positive at deal time; Phase 3 ATLAS-UC launched post-close. Sell-side peak sales consensus in IBD ranged $3-7B depending on UC + Crohn's + RA penetration assumptions. The $5B midpoint reflects standard analyst assumptions for a first-in-class biologic in IBD.
selection_rationale: Largest recent (2023) single-asset autoimmune monoclonal antibody M&A with public deal terms. Phase 2 asset M&A multiple is meaningfully discounted vs Phase 3 / approved assets — useful for calibrating expectations on developmental autoimmune biologics.
source: Merck press release Apr 16 2023; Prometheus SEC filings; sell-side consensus pre-deal (Cowen, Goldman, Morgan Stanley).
